title: cordiera obtusa
intro: Cordiera obtusa, commonly known as "una de gato" or "cat's claw," is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is a woody vine with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cordiera obtusa include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cordiera obtusa include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as modulating the immune system and reducing inflammation.
